name: long-form-content
description: Claude Code plugin: produce long-form content (books, research reports, screenplays and audiobooks) with teams of subagents. Definition, planning, research, parallel unit drafting, review (including a seam reviewer for the joins between units), then a production stage per type: typeset-and-handoff, PDF export, Fountain, or spoken script, per-chapter TTS and a chaptered m4b. Organised so no single agent is ever given a task large enough to degrade. Successor to book-writing.
